google_settings: Show "In a meeting" beside your name while your Google Calendar says you're busy. Connect Google Calendar first — only free/busy times are read, never titles or attendees.
Use out-of-office events from your Google Calendar to mark yourself out automatically. Connect Google Calendar first — only the event type and times are read, never titles or details.
